From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rajesh Srinivasan <rajesh.srinivasan@nova-oem.com>, cloud-sr@bigcloud.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Staged provisioning cadence + vendor response playbook for Acme AI

Team + Rajesh + BigCloud,

Per Acme's contract milestone (DEAL-2026-0923), they want a phased onramp: a small staging pool in Jan, followed by a larger reserved block in Apr. Before I write the MAP, I need concrete lead-time and cadence commitments from both OEM and cloud.

Ask: can Nova/OEM supply staggered rack delivery (8 racks in Jan, remaining 24 racks by end of Q2) and confirm procurement lead times? BigCloud — can you confirm reserve window options and whether we can hold a soft reservation for the staging pool pending PO?

Key constraints:
- Staging pool must be online within 6 weeks of PO signature for customer POC.
- Production reserved capacity must be sustained before April ramp.
- We need all vendor SLAs for latency and maintenance windows documented to attach to the MAP.

I cc Cara (Acme) to keep them in the loop — they asked for milestone dates today.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Staged provisioning cadence + vendor response playbook for Acme AI

Hi Ben + team,

Thanks for outlining. Preliminary availability and constraints from Nova: we can support a staggered delivery schedule but with caveats tied to build slots and transport. Current realistic ETA windows:
- Prototype/staging racks (8 units): earliest ship date 2027-01-20, lead time ~5 weeks from PO due to chassis allocation.
- Bulk racks (24 units): earliest phased shipments starting 2027-03-15 with completion by 2027-05-30, subject to final allocation confirmation.

Notes and risks:
- Pricing in attached quote is indicative and assumes 3rd-party networking build remains unchanged. Any custom rework adds 2–3 weeks.
- We can provide a firm hold on build slots for a 21-day window after PO if a deposit is provided.

Attached: Nova_OEM_RackQuote_Q4_v2.pdf (rack-level BOM and tentative ship windows).

We'll need a signed order and deposit to lock the Jan staging slot. Happy to hop on a quick call to sync on shipment phasing.

Regards,
Rajesh Srinivasan
Sales Engineering Manager, Nova OEM

Subject: Re: Staged provisioning cadence + vendor response playbook for Acme AI

Hi Ben, Tessa, team —

Thanks for the heads-up. For Reserved Capacity we offer two paths:
1) Soft-hold (no billing) for up to 30 days while PO is finalized — subject to region-specific limits.
2) Committed reservation in the us-west-2 region with a minimum 3-month commitment to secure capacity (we can make the production tranche available from 2027-04-01 if contract signed by 2027-01-10).

For the staging pool, we can provision a small GPU cluster on our burst pool within 2–3 weeks of receiving the reservation request (no physical hardware shipping required). That meets the "PO + 6 weeks" ask if you take option 1 and then convert to option 2 for production.

Attached is a high-level reserved quote and the reservation checklist: BigCloud_ReservedQuote.xlsx.

Let me know if you want a quick technical session to map instance types to the Nova rack BOM — we can align on performance/cost tradeoffs.

Best,
Ellen Park
Enterprise Sales, BigCloud
attachments: BigCloud_ReservedQuote.xlsx
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Srinivasan <rajesh.srinivasan@nova-oem.com>, BigCloud Sales <cloud-sr@bigcloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged provisioning cadence + vendor response playbook for Acme AI

Rajesh / Ellen — quick technical clarifications from infra:

- Staging pool constraints: we will stand up a controlled 8-rack staging cluster (same instance types as prod) inside Nova hardware for performance parity. Needs to be online no later than 2027-02-10 to meet POC cadence. Jan ship + 2 weeks for racking/config should be OK if PO is in this week.
- Network: we require a dedicated cross-connect between Nova racks and BigCloud region for KV cache warmup and telemetry. Lead time for cross-connect may add 10–14 days — please call this out in the MAP.
- Spare parts & maintenance: request a 6-month spare-parts list and RMA SLA; if Nova can't provide onsite spares we need a rapid-swap SLA with clear escalation.

I'll draft a technical Appendix for the MAP and drop it in the shared Drive folder.

Dev
Dev Patel
Head of Infra Ops, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Staged provisioning cadence + vendor response playbook for Acme AI

Thanks everyone — summary and proposed MAP milestones below (I'll finalize and circulate as a doc):

Milestone A (staging):
- PO signed + deposit by 2026-12-22 to lock Nova Jan build slot.
- Nova ships 8 racks by 2027-01-20; Redwood to complete racking/config in 2 weeks (target online 2027-02-03).
- BigCloud to provide burst staging cluster or soft-hold reservation to cover cross-connect testing within 2–3 weeks of reservation request.

Milestone B (production reservation):
- Contract converted to committed reservation by 2027-01-10 to secure 2027-04-01 production tranche from BigCloud.
- Nova to phase remaining 24 racks between 2027-03-15 and 2027-05-30 (final ship dates confirmed after deposit).

Open items / risks:
- Cross-connect lead times (Dev: add 10–14 days to MAP).
- If Nova needs >21-day hold to secure slots, finance/procurement needs to approve larger deposit.
- Final BOM cost variance if networking changes are requested.

Actions:
- Rajesh: confirm firm ship windows and deposit amount required to lock Jan slot (reply by EOD 12/15).
- Ellen (BigCloud): confirm soft-hold mechanics and whether we can convert staging to committed reservation without rework.
- Dev: upload technical appendix to Drive and call out cross-connect steps.
- Ben/Marissa: finalize MAP doc (I started a draft and attached it).

Attached: MAP_Acme_DEAL-2026-0923.docx

I'll schedule a 30-min alignment call after we get Rajesh/Ellen replies.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategic Programs, Redwood Inference

Tessa — good summary. From GTM/AE side:

- I'll push for the deposit approval today; procurement finance may ask for a business justification (I have the POC timeline and customer executive email ready).
- If Rajesh confirms Jan slot with a deposit amount under $50k we'll move fast. If it's higher, I need a quick approval path from finance (cc'ing CFO ops in a separate thread).
- Ben and I will finalize the MAP and route it for signatures once Rajesh confirms numbers.

One more ask: include a clause that allows Redwood to convert the staging pool into a billing credit if Nova cannot meet the Jan ship date (we should avoid being double-billed).

Marissa
